WITH orders_s AS (
  SELECT
    order_id AS ord_id,
    customer_id AS cust_id
  FROM orders
),
customers_s AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id AS cust_id,
    customer_unique_id AS cust_uid,
    customer_state AS customer_state
  FROM customers
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.cust_uid,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM orders_s o
  JOIN customers_s c USING (cust_id)
  GROUP BY c.cust_uid
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT cust_uid
  FROM totals
  ORDER BY total_orders DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
  t.cust_uid AS cust_uid,
  c.customer_state AS customer_state,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders_s o
JOIN customers_s c USING (cust_id)
JOIN top3 t ON c.cust_uid = t.cust_uid
GROUP BY t.cust_uid, c.customer_state
ORDER BY (SELECT total_orders FROM totals WHERE cust_uid = t.cust_uid) DESC, t.cust_uid, c.customer_state;
